title: Kissed Herbal Egyptian Lentils Stew
description: A fragrant, herbal lentil stew infused with smoky paprika and agar-agar, perfect for hangover recovery and served in a colorful bento box.
instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold water until clear.
Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat and add cumin seeds, letting them pop for 30 seconds.
Add onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and sauté until the vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in turmeric, coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then add the lentils and reduce heat to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the liquid has thickened.
While the stew simmers, dissolve agar-agar powder in 100 ml hot water, whisk until fully dissolved, then stir the mixture into the stew to set into a gelatinous layer.
Season with salt to taste, stir in fresh parsley, transfer the stew into a bento box, and let it cool before dividing into compartments for a colorful, sattvic-friendly meal.
